key_idea: Pure simulation with the card table from the attached heroes.json: sum powers per side per location with three abilities applied.
sketch: Hard-code the 12 card powers. Per location and player sum base power, add +6 for a Thunderheart when the player has exactly 4 cards there (only the base power is doubled), +5 for Zenith at the centre location, and +(cards-1) for each Seraphina (buffs every other friendly card, including other Seraphinas). Compare location wins, then total power as tiebreaker, else Tie. The card data is only in the statement attachment/images, not in the scraped text.
